Cufant

Steel

Galar · Generation 8

Cufant is a Steel-type Copperderm Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 100 kg. It evolves into Copperajah. Its highest base stat is Attack (80), with a base stat total of 330.
